name: Moon Sickle, +1

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 sickle; +1 to your Druid and Ranger spell attacks and save DC; healing spells you cast heal 1d4 more.
text: A faint moonlit sheen plays along this sickle's silver blade. Attack and damage rolls made with the magic weapon gain +1, and while you hold it, your Druid and Ranger spells get +1 to spell attack rolls and to their saving throw DCs. It also serves as a Spellcasting Focus for those spells. Healing spells you cast while holding it restore an extra 1d4 Hit Points.
